name: series_id
description: ABS series identifier uniquely identifying a time series across ABS releases
observations: Primary key; stable ABS-wide identifier such as A2133244X

name: description
description: Full description of the data item as published by the ABS

name: unit
description: Unit of measure of the series as published by the ABS

name: frequency
description: Publication frequency of the series, Quarter or Annual

name: source_catalogue
description: ABS catalogue number the series is published under
observations: 3101.0 for the population estimates and 3222.0 for the projections

name: source_table
description: Title of the source ABS table the series is published in

name: series_start
description: Date of the first observation of the series

name: series_end
description: Date of the last observation of the series
